lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs are visible along the lateral flank, arranged in at least four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the pectoral fin transition. The blobs increase in diameter and spacing as they move posteriorly from the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Multiple vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observed crossing the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a checkerboard-like grid. Intersections typically coincide with the centroids of the larger circular blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least three prominent horizontal linear features are visible. The mid-lateral carina exhibits a sharp gradient, with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal aspect transitioning to lower-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 10-12 high-luminance blobs. These are arranged in irregular vertical columns, following the posterior curvature of the fin edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple smaller commensal fish (remoras) located ventrally to the mid-section and near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
